summary: The filing is a Form 6-K containing a notice and proxy statement for Alpha Tau Medical Ltd.'s annual general meeting of shareholders to be held on June 23, 2026. The agenda includes routine matters such as re-election of Class II directors, re-approval of compensation policy, and re-appointment of the CEO. There are no special situation events like acquisitions, divestitures, or activist campaigns. This is a routine annual meeting notice with no strategic or structural change.
